basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Practice card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, bold silhouettes, monumental environmental scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large calm color masses, and the sharpest contrast only at the action. Early twentieth-century adventure book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. Include two or three human figures; all faces completely indiscernible, shown from behind, distant, masked by helmets, or in deep shadow. Put the action, key tool or material, and principal figures in the UPPER CENTRAL 45 percent because game UI covers the lower half. The lower half is subdued and quiet. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter, or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.borderTolling: At a monumental frontier arch, one helmeted guard receives a single gold coin from a hooded caravan trader while another guard watches the cart. The hands and small bright coin form a precise focal point, vast gate and distant road show scale. No visible faces.
assets.escortService: Three helmeted escorts flank a heavily laden merchant cart as it crosses a long narrow stone bridge over a great gorge. One escort raises a plain shield toward unseen danger; shield edge catches the sole warm light. Cart and figures small within vast terrain.
assets.watchkeeping: Atop a vast fortress wall at night, three small helmeted watchers tend a beacon. One raises a torch to ignite the great iron brazier; the first flame is focal against immense dark battlements and blue-black sky. Faces obscured.
assets.patrolling: Three cloaked border guards move along a high ridge path through a vast dark forest. The lead patrol raises a lantern and points toward a single fresh footprint in pale mud; lantern and gesture are focal. Immense trees and valley recede, no faces.
assets.garrisonDuty: Three helmeted defenders brace a massive timber gate within a monumental stone fortress. The nearest drives a heavy crossbar into its iron socket while the others hold the door; the warm-lit bar and joined hands are focal. Giant dark wall dwarfs them.
assets.monsterHunting: Three tiny hooded hunters stand at the edge of a moonlit clearing, spears aimed toward the huge indistinct silhouette of a forest monster beyond the mist. One pale spear tip and a single reflected eye are focal; ancient trees dwarf both hunters and creature. No gore, no detailed monster face.
assets.borderSkirmishing: At a windswept border ford, two small helmeted groups meet in a brief spear clash while a third figure backs away. Crossing spear shafts make one sharp X silhouette against pale river light; distant cliffs and storm sky create scale. No visible faces, blood or gore.
assets.scouting: Three hooded scouts kneel high above a vast unknown valley, one lifts a small blank parchment map while pointing toward a distant settlement. The pointing hand and pale map are focal; huge layered terrain dominates. All backs to viewer, no faces or map labels.
assets.horseRelays: At a tiny roadside relay shelter beneath immense mountains, a cloaked rider passes a sealed leather satchel to a second rider already mounted on a fresh horse while a third handles the tired horse. The airborne satchel between hands is focal, powerful diagonal motion.
assets.sagaKeeping: In a vast dark hall, one old hooded warrior seen from behind raises a battered sword as two cloaked listeners sit across a bright hearth. Sword and firelight make the focal story gesture; towering roof beams and shield shapes recede. No faces, no legible writing.
assets.heroicCompany: Three helmeted warriors stand small beneath a monumental hall arch, joining three plain swords overhead in a solemn oath. The meeting steel blades catch one brilliant shaft of dawn light; broad cloaks and stone columns form a heroic triangular silhouette. No faces or emblems.
assets.scavengerArmourers: Within a vast ruined battlefield armory, three hooded workers salvage damaged breastplates from fallen racks. One lifts a clean silver plate from rubble into a pale sunbeam while others gather tools and shields. The metal curve is focal, no bodies or gore.
